t: Procurement Operations and Master Data Specialist
content: Role highlights: - Procurement Operations and Master Data Specialist - Location: Warsaw (Poland) - Department: Financial Operations - Reports to: Global Supplier Finance Operations Lead - Employment type: Permanent - Workplace model: Hybrid - Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) Why this role matters: Keep the procure-to-pay process running accurately and on time, own the quality of the supplier, item and category data that every downstream process depends on. Be the first line of control for supplier onboarding, requisition and PO flow, and invoice and payment exceptions, and make sure the data in the ERP and procurement system is clean, compliant and auditable. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Your day-to-day responsibilities Procurement operations - Process and monitor requisitions and purchase orders, resolving blocked or rejected requests with requesters and approvers. - Ensure POs are priced from contracts and catalogs where available and flag off-contract buying. - Support goods receipt and service confirmation, chasing missing receipts that hold up invoices. - Resolve invoice match exceptions (2-way and 3-way) with suppliers, AP and budget owners. - Respond to supplier and internal queries through the ticketing system within agreed SLAs. - Produce regular reports on PO compliance, cycle
